description: A clear plastic tub sits in the middle on a pink sheet, and a small red-and-white box lies to the right of it while the left hand rests near the bottom left. The right hand reaches in from the right to grasp the small box as a right-hand object, lifts it up and carries it leftward over the tub, then releases it so it drops into the tub while the left hand stays still and does not touch anything.
